articleTitle: A hierarchical security architecture of VANET
abstract: VANET security has attracted increasing attention from scholars with far-reaching research development. Only when both security of VANET and transportation are guaranteed, civil life and property security are surely defended. After highlighting the urgency and complicacy in solving the VANET security concern by the system, we confirm that security system architecture serves as a protective shield against overall threats. Targeted at all risks and challenges VANET is confronted with, this article summarizes existing security system architecture for the time being, sorted generalizes current architectures according to backstop technologies and specifies characteristics and technical issues in separate security system architecture respectively based on PKI, ID and situation modelling. The hierarchical framework of VANET Security System Architecture is significantly stressed on, as the whole secure background in VANET relies on bilateral coordination of self-accomplishment in each hierarchy and mutual support for one another. Core technology applicable in each hierarchy for VANET is identified and future breach for relevant research is exposed.

articleTitle: A secure mechanism for networked control systems based on TrueTime
abstract: Networked control systems (NCSs) have been widely used in industrial areas, and the application of network shows many advantages, while it also makes systems vulnerable to attacks from malicious outsiders. This brief analyses the security issues of data communication as well as the detection and response of cyber attacks based on TrueTime toolbox. We design a detection module on the basis of implementation of data encryption and decryption using Data Encryption Standard (DES) algorithm, furthermore, to protect NCSs from getting out of control, we design a response module. Then we model deception attacks and DOS attacks to test and verify the detection and response parts. According to the experimental results of a DC motor networked control system in TrueTime, our proposed secure mechanism shows its great feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A click-through rate prediction model and its applications to sponsored search advertising
abstract: Ad click-through rate (CTR) prediction is to estimate CTR with click log, which is influenced by the page information, the position, the user properties, the nature features of ad and some other factors. The right ads for the query and the order they are displayed greatly affects the revenue the company receives from these ads. Therefore, it is important to be able to estimating CTR precisely with click log in sponsored search advertising system. We present a useful CTR prediction model for ads of abundant history data. We also show that using our model improves the performance of an advertising system.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: A blended feature selection method in text classification
abstract: In text classification system, accuracy is a major indicator of performance, and feature selection method has a significant impact on it. In this paper, we propose a blended feature selection method, which combines four traditional feature selection methods (document frequency, information gain, mutual information and chi-square) into a better feature selection method. BFSM is tested on a Chinese corpus of 4000 documents and improves the accuracy compared with those traditional methods.

articleTitle: Gaussian mixture model for background based automatic fall detection
abstract: It's very dangerous for the elderly to fall, so fall detection is very important in nowadays society. This paper addresses to detect fall activities by combing Gaussian mixture model (GMM) and special-temporal analysis of aspect ratio. First, we use GMM to get the background part and foreground part from an image. After morphological operations, some small gaps are removed by empirical knowledge from the foreground part. Second, we calculate the aspect ratio feature from the minimum external rectangle of a human body. Through the spatial-temporal analysis of aspect ratio, we output the fall behaviour more robust. The experiments show that our approach can effectively detect human falls in real time.

articleTitle: An improved JoBS algorithm for queue schedule of HF gateway
abstract: To provide QoS support in HF networks, this paper analyzes the traffic models in HF network, combined with the characteristics of HF network. According to these traits, the requirements that need to be considered in queue scheduling algorithm of HF gateway is given. JoBS algorithm, which may satisfy the requirements, is suggested to be used in HF gateways. Through simulation in NS2, JoBS is proven to be suitable in HF environment. Besides, an exponent weighting method on loss rate is proposed to solve the problem of priority inversion when the incoming rate is close to the channel rate.

articleTitle: On data transmission system based on the CPCI bus
abstract: Data transmission is an important embodiment for the application of computer, CPCI bus becomes the mainstream of computer bus because of its excellent properties. As a result, data transmission that based on the CPCI bus is widely used. The paper mainly introduces the research and implementation of the system that the PC transmits data with FPGA through CPCI bus. Using VC++6.0 to develop PC program, using PCI9054 chip of PLX company as the interface, using VC++6.0 + DDK + DnverStudio3.1 to establish environment which used to develop driver. The final results of the data transmission are given by means of describing and analyzing the specific implementation about each part.

articleTitle: Image denoising based on non-subsampled shearlet transform
abstract: In this paper, a novel method for image denoising based on non-subsampled shearlet transform (NSST) is proposed which adopts multi-scale geometry tool. Firstly, the image is decomposed into multi-scale and multi-direction sub-band images by using NSST. The NSST coefficients of each direction approach the generalized Gaussian distribution. We use the principal component analysis (PCA) for every similarity window of NSST coefficients. Then we use Generalized Gaussian model of non-local means method to handle the NSST coefficients. Finally, we reconstruct image with the new NSST coefficients to obtain the result. Numerical results show that our algorithm competes favourably with nonlocal means algorithms in the case of high noise.

articleTitle: The law of the distribution in Kads routing table
abstract: In recent years, in the field of file sharing on the Internet, BitTorrent and eMule accounted for a large proportion of the application. The two software have their own proprietary peer-to-peer (P2P) network, and are based on the Kademha protocol development, Kademlia protocol is typical of the DHT(Distnbuted Hash Table) protocol. In eMule, proprietary peer-to-peer (P2P) network is called the KAD network, the goal to detect KAD network is to discover the relationship between the nodes and find new nodes in network rapidly and completely. Optimization of detection, we think, should be based on the distribution in routing table. Our job is to detect some nodes in KAD, and find out the existing laws of routing table. At present, only a few articles that involves detection of the routing table, but there is not enough analysis to summarize laws. In our experiment, We have developed a crawler, called Y-CRAWLER. We used it to crawl the KAD, and found one million and five hundred thousand nodes in one time. We have detected some of their routing table, found out that their routing table is not always in full. The detection results show that the actual routing table structure of KAD network nodes has clustering property. The neighboring nodes center on the upper 20 layers of the similar binary tree structure of the routing table, and the first 15 layers occupy more than 85% of the nodes.

articleTitle: Codebook-based hybrid opportunistic interference alignment
abstract: In this paper, we propose a codebook-based hybrid opportunistic interference alignment (OIA) in a three-cell MIMO downlink system. Rather than transmitting data by only one beamforming vector set in the conventional OIA, the transmitters select a preferred transmit beamforming vector set from a codebook in the proposed scheme. Hence, more selection diversity is developed compared to the conventional OIA approaches, The sum rate performance increases as the size of the codebook grows. Furthermore, a hybrid criterion of MAX-SNR and OIA is put forward which enhances the system performance at both high and low SNR. Monte-Carlo simulations illustrate that the proposed scheme provides a significant improvement in terms of sum rates with a slight complexity increase

articleTitle: Chaos-based secure scheme against DNS hijacking in the IP Multimedia Subsystem
abstract: In this paper, a chaos-based secure scheme is proposed to defense against DNS hijacking in IP Multimedia Subsystem. The proposed secure scheme encrypts the identifier of the DNS inquiry messages with IMS AKA and NDS keys using Henon chaos algorithm, and the hijacker cannot intrude a legal DNS response to redirect the victim to a malicious destination. The performance evaluation demonstrates that the proposed chaos-based secure scheme is effective and the overall delay and overhead brought in are analyzed to be within the common scale.

articleTitle: Research on anti-interference method of underwater acoustic communication based on OFDM
abstract: The application of underwater acoustic communication is more and more widely, but the problems of the limited channel bandwidth, strong noise, and strong multi-path and other issues seriously affect the quality of information transmission. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) technology has features of high bandwidth efficiency, good ability to resistance to multipath and impulse noise, so a high-performance underwater acoustic communication scheme based on OFDM is proposed here, which combines the Trellis Coded Modulation (TCM) and Frequency Hopping (FH) communication technology. Simulation results show that the scheme not only has higher band utilization rate, but also can effectively reduce the error rate and improve the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Established at the beginning: VoD users' loyalty, lifespan and visiting pattern
abstract: Watching ‘on-demand’ video on the Internet is popular. Provider sare paying more attention on mining user behaviour data to improve service quality and attract more loyal users. It is desired to characterize evolution process of user engagement. While there are models characterizing engagement of traditional customers and web users, there still lacks an appropriate metric of user's loyalty for VoD systems. In this paper, we prove that users can be categorized into three groups based on the following three weekly visiting patterns: routine, random and rare visiting. We introduce a model from Web Data Analysis theory to present loyalty of a VoD user. It integrates the following four metrics for a user's engagement: 1) recency, i.e. number of weeks the user does not visit the system since his last visit; 2) frequency, i.e. number of days the user visits the system per week; 3) number of movies that the user watches per week and 4) mean finish rate of the user's all watching sessions per week. We find that finish rate is the most important feature to characterize user loyalty; and users of routine pattern visit more frequently and watch more videos with higher finish rate every week than others. Moreover, we find that a user's visiting pattern, lifespan and engagement can be established from his initial watching behaviour of the first week after he joined the system. This suggests that a VoD system paying more efforts to provide new comers who are in their first week arriving the system with better watching expenence may foster more loyal users.

articleTitle: Research on interference cancellation of quasi-synchronous visible light communication systems
abstract: Optical code division multiple access (OCDMA) is an attractive technology to accommodate the simultaneous transmission from several emitters by assigning a unique code to each emitter, and reduce the multiple access interference (MAI) by the good correlation property of the code set. In this paper, a new code set who has zero correlation zone (ZCZ) property is proposed for visible light communications (VLC) system. Both the multiple access interference (MAI) and phase-induced intensity noise (PUN) noise of the VLC system can be eliminated directly by utilizing the proposed code set as the signature codes.

articleTitle: Inspirations for office document formats from web office
abstract: With the rapid development of Cloud Computing and Mobile Internet Technology, people gradually move rich client applications to browser-based thin client. This new development model of application brings great opportunities and challenges for the development of office document. Facing the requirements of Mobile Office and Collaborative Editing, domestic and foreign office software manufacturers have combined the development of office software with the application of network. By analysing the existing office document formats and the web office systems, this essay made a profound summary for their advantages and disadvantages. Based on those conclusions, future development ideas of the office document formats have been proposed. This research work has an important role in the future development of the office document format.

articleTitle: A Trust Evaluation model with Elimination of Uncertain Recommendation
abstract: According to the problem of random recommendation for some entities, a Trust Evaluation model with Elimination of Uncertain Recommendation (EURTrust) is presented in this paper. In EURTrust model, entities are classified into two types, certain behaviours and uncertain behaviours, on the basis of recommendation behavior trajectory. Recommendation of those with uncertain behaviours will not be taken into account. Entity trust is determined by the recommended trust and recommend evidence of the recommended entities, and recommended trust reflects the entity recommended history. Analysis and simulation results demonstrate that EURTrust have a good ability of elimination of uncertain recommendation.

articleTitle: A secure biometric-based authentication scheme using smart card
abstract: Authentication scheme is important and widely used in various environments, including cloud computing. Among these authentication schemes, password-based authentication schemes are easy to deploy. Furthermore, a three-factor (password, smart card and biometric) authentication scheme adds more secure factors to authentication process. In 2012, An pointed out that a three-factor authentication scheme proposed by Das was vulnerable to various attacks. Then An suggested an improvement. He claimed that his scheme was more secure than the scheme given by Das. However, we demonstrate that his scheme is still under attacking. We then introduce an enhanced protocol to overcome such problems. The proposed scheme is more secure than the previous related works and maintains high performance.

articleTitle: An anonymous signcryption scheme based on one-off public key
abstract: One-off public key can not only achieve the security of user's privacy, its traceability can also reveal the malicious user's identity together with the trusted center. At present, At present, being proposed by many scholars, most one-off public key schemes, however, still not secure at present—whose private key, certification and signature been counterfeited by malicious users. The research of anonymous signcryption based on one-off public key is almost vacant. This paper proposes a new anonymous signcryption scheme based on one-off public key which has an efficient algorithm, and what's more, whose anonymity and traceabihty can prevent attack from untrusted clients and malicious users.

articleTitle: Multilayer satellite network routing based on Hypergraph theory
abstract: Because of the periodic orbit motion, the space communications network nodes are predictable by analyzing the law of satellite operation. We create space geometry model for periodic motion orbit of nodes, and the multilayer satellite network routing is proposed based on Hypergraph theory (HMSR). The simulation results show that the delay stability of the satellite network can be improved and thus enhance the reliability.

articleTitle: The massive MU-MIMO system with optimal number of users through linear precoders
abstract: In this paper, the downlink (DL) of the multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) system is investigated, where channel estimation and large-scale fading are taken into consideration and the number of antennas M at the base station (BS) is extremely large. We calculate the asymptotic sum rate of singular value decomposition (SVD)-based precoder and regularized zero-forcing (RZF) precoder. The optimal number of served users is taken into account. The result shows that M should be more than the product of the number of users and the number of antennas at each user. Based on the optimal number, we propose a convenient data stream allocation strategy aiming to improve the system sum rate, meanwhile maintaining the number of simultaneously served users. Numerical simulations reveal that our approximations are appropriate for the large-scale MU-MIMO system and the proposed data stream allocation can provide significant improvement in sum-rate performance.

articleTitle: Research of centralized multicast key management for LEO satellite networks
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and modern communication technology, LEO satellite networks have become one of the researching focuses for its broadband multimedia communications services and making personal communications available. But the wireless communications and broadcasting characteristics make LEO satellite networks vulnerable. The paper proposed a centralized multicast key management scheme based on hierarchical domain one-way function tree (HD-OFT). And through the performance comparative analysis, it can be effective in reducing the computational overhead of gateway server and bandwidth of satellite networks, and increasing resource utilization rate.

articleTitle: Text classification dimension reduction algorithm for Chinese web page based on deep learning
abstract: Nowadays, due to the development of network technology, the Internet becomes the main resource for people to obtain information. The openness of the network makes the network abound of all kinds of information, so it becomes more and more important that using network text classification techniques enable people to get the information they are interested in quickly from the mixed and disorderly network information. Since network text classification technology is the basis of information filtering, search engines, and other fields, it has gradually become a research focus. The traditional text classification technology can't effectively support the Chinese web page text classification because of the large scale of Chinese web page text. An important way to learn the data feature from massive data is to use deep learning neural network structure. Deep learning network has excellent feature learning ability. It can combine objects of low-level features to form advanced abstract representations of the object which will be more suitable for classification. This paper proposes a new deep learning based text classification model to solve the problem of Chinese web text categorization of dimension reduction. Moreover we verify the feasibility of this method through the experiment.

articleTitle: A utility-based OFDM resource allocation scheme for LEO small satellite system
abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) small satellite communication networks, operating at higher band, play a significant role to the worldwide information network. Satellite-earth wireless channel fading is the prime impairment factor for degrading the performance of the network. As a pervasive technology used in the fourth-generation (4G) system, OFDM sub-carrier allocation is one of the key issues for satellite network. In this paper, we set up a utility-based framework and maximize the total throughput, considering different quality of service (QoS) requirements of multi-services. Based on the experienced delay, the services queuing delay and delay deadline threshold, we propose a ULHA (Utility-Lagrange-Heuristic Algorithm) for solving the sub-carrier allocation. In the strategy, using the delay from the satellite to mobile terminal, the heuristic algorithm is suggested and simulated. Simulation results show that the sub-carrier allocation algorithms have balanced the system performance between efficiency and fairness. The QoS of real-time services has been well satisfied in the LEO small satellite communication networks.

articleTitle: Mathematic model for statu space transfer in dynamics system and reciprocal calculation method for status transfer
