articleTitle: A weighted event decision mechanism for cyberspace
abstract: In cyberspace, there are decision nodes which include several processors. Proper mechanism of events decision is needed to maximum the processors utilization. This mechanism is also effect to pick up the event most important and can be handled quickly. In this paper, a weighted event decision mechanism was advanced. In this mechanism, a weighted factor is used to mark each event which enters the decision node buffer by its type of operation and decision time. This mechanism is fully taken into account to the limited loads and the real-time processing requirements of wisdom network decision nodes. The simulation results show that, this mechanism improved the processors utilizing efficiency better than FIFO.

articleTitle: An improved Sum rule for multi-unit biometric fusion based on MCYT database
abstract: Most of the research on multi-unit fingerprint recognition at the moment, due to the lack of corresponding data, is based on simulated data or virtual human rather than genuine multi-unit data. On the basis of the genuine multi-unit fingerprint data from a subset of MCYT-Fingerprint database, this paper studies the fusion algorithm of multi-unit fingerprint recognition and proposes an improved Sum rule for multi-unit biometric systems. Experiment results show that the improved Sum can gain better performance.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic filters based on phase modulator and Fiber Bragg Gratings
abstract: A novel microwave photonic filter is proposed based on phase modulator and Fiber Bragg Gratings in this paper. Using the bipolar properties of the gratings, both a high-Q band-pass filter and a notch filter can be switched by adjusting the attenuators. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the filter performances are influenced by the zero pole position of the transfer function, and then the system simulation results show that a frequency response of a high Q band-pass filter with a Q factor of 114 and a rejection ratio of around 45 dB, and a flat notch frequency response with Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</inf> value exceeding 48 are obtained. Furthermore, compared with the filters whose signal powers cannot be separately controlled, the proposed notch filter's performances is improved through separately controlling signal powers.

articleTitle: An Energy-saving QoS Routing Protocol in green Internet
abstract: Recently, an explosive increase in Internet and its applications have led to a sharply rising in the energy consumption and cooling cost of devices in Internet. A “green networking” idea has been proposed to solve the issues referring to a variety of economic and environmental consequences for recent years. Based on the well known OSPFv3 protocol, an Energy-saving QoS Routing Protocol (EQRP) for green Internet is proposed in this paper, including the designs and implementations of information sensing module routing module, sleeping management module and protocol monitor module. It is compared with OSPFv3 protocol from various aspects, such as power consumption convergence time, impacts from topological changes, resources utilization on CPU and storage and so on. Experiments have shown that EQRP is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Application of distinguishable weight based unascertained measure model in water quality assessment
abstract: The method of traditional fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model has one-sidedness in determining index weight and its evaluation results sometimes can't fully and truly reflect the water quality. Based on unascertained comprehensive evaluation model this paper studies the water quality of Changjiang River in recent two years. Firstly, by preliminarily analyzing the water quality of Changjiang River, this paper obtains a more scientific evaluation index system. Then, through using distinguishable weight to determine the weight between each index and distinguishing the difference between each index weight, this paper establishes an unascertained measure comprehensive evaluation model of these index systems on the basis of meeting the consistency check. Finally, by instance analysis, the paper indicates that the results achieved by unascertained measure comprehensive evaluation model is basically in line with the practical situation and have great application and promotion value.

articleTitle: Wisdom security model against internal attackers for cyberspace
abstract: This paper investigates a wisdom security model against internal attackers for cyberspace. The objective is to find the defensive measures are optimized with respect to threats launched by malicious attackers, and allow the defenders to choose their optimal control strategies contingent upon the state of game. Our model provides a new method to effectively decrease the number of attackers in cyberspace under the optimal control strategies of the defenders.

articleTitle: A multi feature fusion clustering algorithm based on Q&A community
abstract: In this paper, a multi feature fusion clustering algorithm based on the Q&A community is presented, which to extract the candidate label by performing clustering on the Q-A pairs. It is proposed to combine TF/IDF, context information entropy, word length as feature to extract, select and score keywords. The experiment not only confirms effectiveness the compared with the traditional system, but also validates the precision of the multi feature fusion model.

articleTitle: Moving target detection in the binocular vision system
abstract: The video surveillance system has been widely used in the field of security monitoring. The binocular vision system could provide more information of monitored targets and has unique advantages in analysis of suspicious targets and understanding of images. Currently, the research and application of the binocular vision system has been widely concerned by domestic and foreign researchers. Moving target detection is developing and innovating as the primary problem in the most visual system. In this paper, three classic algorithms of moving target detection have been introduced: background difference method, frame difference method and optical flow method. After compassion and analysis of the three algorithms through the experiment, the study concludes that the background difference method based on the mixed Gaussian model has some advantages in binocular vision system.

articleTitle: Optimal transmission distance of mean progress and mean transport in device-to-device networks
abstract: In this paper, stochastic geometry is used to quantitatively solve the issue of optimal transmission distance in device-to-device hybrid network. Two interference sources are taken into account: mobiles transmitting to base stations, and mobiles transmitting to other mobiles. Transmission distance is assumed equal in this paper, and we explore the optimal transmission distance of mean progress and mean transport, that is, the product of transmission distance and coverage probability, and the product of transmission distance and throughput, respectively. Parameters such as intensity of mobiles, the proportion of mobile regarded as device transmitters, signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio requirement, ratio of transmit power of macro terminals to mobile devices, and path loss exponent, are considered in our mathematical expressions. In this paper, we illustrate how the stochastic geometry can be used in studying the device-to-device issues, and how the optimal transmission distance changes regarding the parameters.

articleTitle: Application of multi-level α-β-γ filter in velocity measurement
abstract: Applying the multi-level α-β-γ filter to smooth the measured value, based on the theory of navigation velocity measurement, can improve the accuracy of measured velocity for navigational receiver. By switching parameters of filter, the problem that traditional and single α-β-γ filter fail to satisfy both smoothing accuracy and convergence rate can be solved. Moreover, this method not only simplifies the theory but also reduces the amount of calculation. Therefore, it is suitable for this method to be used by a high-dynamic navigation receiver in real time. The experimental results have indicated that the expectation is achieved, especially improving smoothing accuracy and convergence rate.

articleTitle: Comparisons of image matching methods in binocular vision system
abstract: Binocular vision system can be divided into different parts, and image matching is the one and very important component in this system. In this paper, the basic procedure of image matching algorithm is researched, and the classification of the image matching is analyzed due to the difference of matching primitives. Then the characters of the surveyed methods, including the advantage, disadvantage and application prospects are compared. Based on the analysis and experiment results, the algorithms based on Harris angular points, SIFT, SURF is compared. At lost, the next research direction and hotspot topic of image matching is discussed.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and optimization of the interference-limited multi-hop wireless relaying system
abstract: This letter investigates the performance of multi-hop amplify-and-forward (AF) wireless relaying systems over interference-limited Rayleigh fading channels where both the relays and the destination subjected to multiple co-channel interferences. The application of the harmonic mean of the minimum of the first M (0 ≤ M ≤ N) hop signal-to-interferences (SIRs) and the minimum of the remaining N-M hop SIRs make us get a closed-form expression of outage probability. Based on the approximate expression, we optimize the outage probability from three aspects. Monte-Carlo simulation results confirm our analysis and illustrate that the proposed power allocation, relay placement selection and the joint optimization schemes lead to the improvement of the system performance.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of wireless voice system based on central station
abstract: In orde to meet the needs of low-cost, short-range and real-time wireless voice communications, this paper proposes a central base station wireless voice communication system. In accordance with the needs of the system, The Central base station and the end nodes which adopted embedded processor ATMega128L as MCU, RF chip CC2500, codec CMX649 and LCD, power circuit as peripheral equipments was introduced. The design of system structure,hardware,software and communication protocols was discussed in detail, and the system adopts voice data double buffering mechanism. When RF chip is setted 250kbps and codec is setted 16 kbps,the test results show that the double buffer size is setted to more than 40B the wireless voice quality can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Decision feedback threshold selection for UWB TOA estimation with energy detection receiver
abstract: The energy detection receiver is a practical solution for time-of-arrival (TOA) estimation in ultra-wide bandwidth (UWB) ranging with its sub-Nyquist sampling rate. However, the threshold selection under harsh environments is a challenging problem. In this paper, a decision feedback criterion that determines the threshold value is proposed, with which the probability of early false detection can be reduced and the missed detection can be avoided. In this criterion, the threshold is determined by the noise level, and can be adjusted iteratively according to the feedback of the threshold comparing result with a purpose of avoiding missed detection. As a result, the estimation accuracy of the TOA is improved. Simulation results show that significant performance improvement can be derived with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Propagation of computer viruses via pseudo-digital mobile communications networks
abstract: In this paper, the computers accessing Internet networks via the mobile modems for digital mobile communication systems were regarded as the goal objects. Some means including the pseudo network, the standard message and the legal flow were adopted. A technical approach for unsolicited propagating computer viruses to the computers via pseudo digital mobile communication network was presented. Finally, the security precautionary measure was suggested, aimed at the mechanism of computer viruses spreading in pseudo networks for digital mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: Cyberspace based wisdom
abstract: With the development of network technology, this kind of “virtual world” becomes practical. In this paper, we propose a novel architecture for Cyber-space with wisdom, and describe the wisdom of Cyber-space.

articleTitle: Design of miniature photovoltaic power generation system based on ZigBee network technology
abstract: ZigBee network technology is an emerging research field of information science, this paper proposes a miniature photovoltaic power generation system based on ZigBee network technology design scheme and implement, household photovoltaic power generation systems have been discussed in detail in the ZigBee network framework, including information collection, system control, modular design, and sensor network nodes deployment, etc., the system for the center with the coordinator build ZigBee star structure for the micro photovoltaic power generation system of intelligent management and working state real time monitoring. The results show that the ZigBee network technology application in household photovoltaic power generation system, not only improve the level of the information management system, further research on grid type household photovoltaic power station also has important research significance.

articleTitle: Exact analysis of transmit/receive zero-forcing based MIMO af two-way relaying when relay has two antennas
abstract: In this paper, the performance of joint transmit/receive zero-forcing (ZF) is analyzed for multiple-input multiple-out (MIMO) amplify-and-forward (AF) two-way relay network when the relay has two antennas. The performance is studied by deriving exact expressions of the overall outage probability and the diversity order under the uncorrected Rayleigh fading channel and relay-correlated Rayleigh fading channel as well. Analysis and simulation results indicate that, compared to uncorrected Rayleigh fading, spatial correlation at the relay deteriorates the performance of the system greatly, but does not affect the diversity order of the system.

articleTitle: Research of automatic parking system based on license plate recognition
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent parking system for detecting and recognizing license plates automatically, programming with VC++ and QT. In the proposed algorithm, Ticense Plate (TP) location and correction is realized by using high vertical edge characteristic of image and method of horizontal edge detection. After TP segmentation and recognition, the vehicle information which taking TP as the primary key will be stored in system database. Experimental results show that the proposed system can realize Ticense Plate Recognition (TPR) accurately and is applied to real-time implementation for a very short execution time.

articleTitle: Research of transmission loss analysis in deep space communication
abstract: Influenced by the environment, radio signal attenuation is serious in deep space communication. Loss analysis can help to compensate the signal attenuation. This paper, according to the link division, describes the signal attenuation caused by various factors, and their theoretical model is presented at last.

articleTitle: Distributed storage based on cloud computing
abstract: Cloud computing is the next generation of computing model, which plays an important role in the scientific computing and commercial field, and gets attention from the academic and business circles. Distributed storage of data in cloud computing environment in data center of the organization and management, is the core infrastructure of cloud computing environment. In addition, data centers typically consists of millions of nodes, and the scale of the data stored on it often reach PB level or EB, resulting in a normal behavior of data failure data, which greatly limits the application and popularization of cloud computing. Therefore, to improve the scalability fault tolerance to reduce cost, some key technologies of storage distribution of a cloud computing environment are come up with, in order to improve the storage scalability, fault tolerance and reduce memory energy consumption targets, First, this paper introduced and compared the advantages and disadvantages of data center network structure type. Secondly, it introduced and compared the current commonly used two kinds of distributed storage fault-tolerant techniques. Finally, it pointed out the current technologies, the major challenges and the direction of next research.

articleTitle: A broadband signal capture and tracking algorithm based on FPGA
abstract: Capture and tracking is key technology of spread spectrum communication baseband signal processing. For signal with high-speed spread spectrum pseudo code, the traditional capturing and tracking algorithm need to be improved. In order to be able to quickly capture the signal, and make stable tracking, use the NONCOHERENT parallel method, which speeds up the capture speed and efficiency, for tracking, using second-order FLL to aid third-order PLL. The algorithm is implemented in the FPGA with fixed point decimal method. For the pseudo code of 20Mbps rate, actual test results show that, the time for capturing is less than 2 seconds, and the receiver can stand the received signal frequency changes in more than 2 KHz/s at tracking state.

articleTitle: Research of GNSS real-time pseudorange differential positioning technology
abstract: In the thesis, two pieces of tn-mode navigation receiver board are respectively used as base station and mobile station, communicate through RS232 serial port, which can form a difference positioning system. By analyzing principle of pseudorange differential positioning and the methods of RTCM encoding and decoding, to make them implementation respectively in DSP of the base station and mobile receivers. The experimental results show that accuracy can be doubled by pseudorange differential positioning. It fully verifies correctness of the algorithm and provides a basis for further study.

articleTitle: Downlink coverage of TD-SCDMA femtocell
abstract: TD-SCDMA indoor coverage is very poor and it is a big issue that needed to be resolved. Femtocell is a good solution to boost the indoor coverage. Femtocell is a very small base station which is deployed in homes or enterprises. Femtocell must have the self-configuration function and be plug-and-play, and most of them work in CSG mode. So femtocell downlink coverage and interference to the neighbouring macrocell caused by femtocell should be studied clearly. This paper focuses on the downlink coverage of femtocell working in the CSG mode and the interference to macrocell. A femtocell power control scheme is proposed, which can automatically adjust the transmission power, according to the macrocell dead spots and femtocell downlink coverage. The simulations show that it is useful to deploy TD-SCDMA Femtocell network.

articleTitle: A high accuracy positioning technology of wireless research and implementation
abstract: Considering the requirements for positioning in the present and future weapon system, a approach for measuring angle and ranging at high accuracy is presented by utilizing wireless data communication link between ground station and aircrafts to locate aircrafts' angle and ranging precisely. In the position system, direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) and frame data format are introduced for data interaction, precisely azimuth of aircraft is figured out by means of long-short base line formed by the antenna array on land, accuracy ranging of dual one-way non-coherent mode is realized by DSSS module asynchronous transfer frame[1]. Technical test and verify is given for azimuth and dual one-way ranging (DSSS) test, and the test result have reached the expected target, and precise positioning is realized.

articleTitle: E-commerce law in cyberspace: Issues, challenges and suggestion
abstract: This paper focuses legislative status of intellectual property and e-commerce's electronic payment, taxes, electronic signatures and electronic authentication in the cyber-space. It detailedly analyzes them and puts forward solutions.

articleTitle: A new High-power led drive power design based on “PFC+LLC+VC, CC” topology structure
abstract: In this paper, a new High-power LED drive power based on “PFC+LLC+VC, CC” topology structures is discussed, it uses LLC half-bridge resonant circuit composed of TM mode PFC controller L6563H and High-pressure resonant controller L6599 to realize zero voltage switching(ZVS) of main power tube and zero current switching(ZCS) of rectifier diode under full voltage scope and full load condition, meanwhile, it uses constant voltage(CV) and constant current(CC) circuit to improve efficiency and power factor of HB-LED drive power. By using this topology structures, the power factor can reach to 97%and the overall efficiency to 92%.

articleTitle: Research on semiconductor lighting engineering situation and development trend
abstract: Semiconductor lighting has the advantages of energy saving, environmental protection, long service life, small size, etc, thus it can be used in all kinds of color and white lighting area. Developing the industry of semiconductor lighting will bring a significant impact on national economy and politics. It will hold back the energy crisis, control and reduce the environmental pollution, and be beneficial to the sustainable development of the national economy. In this paper, the character of semiconductor lighting is introduced; then the present status and industrialization application of semiconductor lighting home and abroad are reviewed; meanwhile, some technology problems that semiconductor lighting industry faces are analyzed. Eventually the developing trend of semiconductor lighting Engineering is also presented.

articleTitle: Service analysis and optimization program of LAN based on OPNET
abstract: This article is in the background of LAN optimize and upgrade, using OPNET simulation software for network modeling, analyze performance to the main service of the network (email, http, ftp), at the same time, according to the results of the analysis, put forward some reasonable network optimization proposes, so as to solve the LAN upgrade the practical problems faced.

articleTitle: A quantization feedback algorithm based on error comparison in multi-basestation cooperation system
abstract: In this study, a quantization feedback algorithm based on error comparison is proposed aiming at the characteristics of base station cooperation system. The algorithm quantizes the channel vector by several steps. During the quantization, the error is compared before the quantization in each step, which reduces the accumulation of quantization error. Meanwhile, the complexity of computation is decreased greatly. It has been shown in complexity analysis and system simulation that compared with the existing global feedback schemes and individual feedback schemes, the proposed scheme achieves a good balance between complexity and system performance.

articleTitle: Secrecy performance of MRT/RAS system with outdated CSI in MIMO wiretap channels
abstract: We analyze the impact of outdated CSI on the security performance in multi-input multi-output (MIMO) system, where the transmitter uses maximal-ratio transmission (MRT) and the receiver uses receive antenna selection (RAS). In our analysis, new closed-form expressions for the probability of the existence of a nonzero secrecy capacity and the secrecy outage probability are derived. Then, based on the exact expressions, we derive the asymptotic secrecy outage probability. These conclusions demonstrate that under the impact of the outdated CSI, the secrecy array gain suffered from some loss, while the receive diversity order is reduced to one and the transmit diversity order is not affected. Theoretical analysis is verified by our simulation results.

articleTitle: Structural design of distributed software system based on component
abstract: We proposed and designed a distributed software architecture framework model based on the component by combining the C/S and B/W/S modes, then discussed the stratification and separation principle of system function decomposition. Application examples in the general query system show that the open architecture is scalable, easy to adapt and so on.

articleTitle: IVIT: A core stateless IPV4/IPV6 transition mechanism combining translation and tunnel technologies
abstract: As a simple IPv4/IPv6 transition mechanism, IVI solves communication problems between IPv4 and NIVI IPv6 networks statelessly (IVI/ NIVI IPv6 network is image of Global IPv4 in IPv6 address family via 1∶1/1:N mapping rule respectively). However, it fails to support communication between IPv4 and non-NIVI IPv6 networks. Current transition technologies such as NAT-PT and NAT64 cannot solve the issue as well. This paper proposes IVIT mechanism, which solves the problem with translation at the edge and tunnel at the core. Merging features of both IVI and Tunnel technologies, IVIT selects CPE at the edge as translation location and utilizes tunnel to load data arrived at the core gateway with IVI address mapping format and 6 to 4 tunnel mechanism. It puts forward address mapping rules embedding IPv4 host's address and CPE's address into IPv6 address, and supports communication between a private IPv4 network and an IPv6 network. IVIT resolves global addresses' shortness and routing scalability issues, and realizes stateless translation and end-to-end transparent communication. Compared with NAT-PT, IVIT has better function and performance with less impact on network, and the defects of IVIT are perfectly acceptable.

articleTitle: A user clustering algorithm considering user's interest-offset
abstract: This paper proposes a user-clustering algorithm against user interest-offset which may lead to inaccuracy of cluster. At first, we builds an item characteristic network diagram. Then we classify more-interested users and interest-offset users with improved Markov algorithm and cluster users with k-means algorithm. The experiment shows that we can get a higher recommender accuracy using this algorithm which is proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: The application of entropy weight unascertained model in mine safety evaluation
abstract: The mine safety evaluation is of great significance for daily safety production management of the mine. The current evaluation methods can not reflect the unascertained or fuzzy state of the mine completely. Firstly, this paper establishes a more systematic, scientific, reasonable index system for the mine safety evaluation, relying on the practical experience and relevant research on system development of Jinshandian iron mine which belongs to Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation (WISCO), determines the weight of each index objectively with the entropy weight method, and then evaluates the mine system safety using the unascertained measure model. Cases show that the result of the mine safety evaluation is in line with the reality, which provides a reliable technical support for the mines' daily safety and normal production, and meanwhile provides a certain explanation and demonstration for potential safety hazards that may occur. Therefore, the model possesses a certain scientific property, rationality and reliability, and has the value of further promotion and application

articleTitle: LtKademlia - Topology matching and load balancing P2P model
abstract: An improved model of LtKademlia and associated routing algorithm based on Kademha are proposed. In this model, a method has been proposed to achieve self-organized clustering by mapping IP address to the node ID to match the logical topology to the physical topology and solve the detaining problem. A routing algorithm based on the node real-time comprehensive performance and logical distance has been designed to adapt the load to the power of the node. The simulation result shows that the query delay of the improved model is less than the original model.

articleTitle: Management process based cloud service security model
abstract: Security problem is considered as one of the greatest challenges in providing cloud computing service. It's essential for success in cloud services business. Existing researches focus on providing security technologies, rather than business features such as services stability, continuity and availability. To fulfil the business requirements, this paper presents a cloud-based security service management processes model. And a new mapping method is used to get assets and processes mapping matrix. Then the dynamic computational model for cloud security risk can be evaluated. By this means, cloud computing services will maintain high availability and continuity; moreover, it satisfies the cloud computing platform and management system security requirements.

articleTitle: A weighted D-S evidence theory based cooperative spectrum sensing to defend PUE attack
abstract: Spectrum sensing technology is the key problem in the cognitive radio system. The primary user emulation (PUE) attacks in physical layer and the shadow of wireless channel is the main factor effect the performance of spectrum sensing. Here we propose a decision-making algorithm of cooperative spectrum sensing based on weighted Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory. The weight is concerned with the relationship between energy and location. MATLAB simulation results show that the proposed D-S algorithm has better detection performance than the SNR-weighted, AND and OR decision-making algorithm, and can effectively combat the shadow effect and PUE attacks.

articleTitle: The design of multi-zone wireless burglar alarm system
abstract: Based on the microcontroller AT89C51, an eight regional wireless burglar alarm system is designed in this paper. This burglar alarm is composed of an infrared sensor chip BISS0001 as a detector, the microcontroller AT89C51 as controller and LX2262/LX2272 as encoder/decoder. Via an external remote controller, it can achieve eight monitored region arming and disarming, and burglar alarming. The design has focused on remote alarming with the distance of 25m, which also can be even enlarged by enhancing the power transmitting circuit as you needed. When using other sensors as detectors, it can be worked as anti-theft alarm, fire alarm, gas-leak alarm and multi-functional alarm system, which will be very useful to Smart Home System.

articleTitle: An optimization model and its algorithm of bulk grain transportation with time windows
abstract: In this paper, a bulk gram transportation problem with time windows is proposed and solved. It is too idealistic and impractical for traditional transportation model to apply because of ignoring shipping time. This paper applies probability and statistics in order to convert transportation time that is not within the time windows into penalty cost, thus formulating a multi-objective model with two goals: (1) minimize the traditional transportation cost and (2) minimize the penalty cost if delayed or ahead of time. A solution algorithm for the optimization model is also proposed and case analysis shows that this proposed model is capable of providing a optimum solution within a short computation time. Managerial insights on bulk gram transportation and gram supply chain governance, especially on the coordination mechanism between gram depots and gram processing companies are drawn.

articleTitle: Method for determining dynamic characteristics analysis and parameters of phase-locked frequency circuit
abstract: This paper introduces the composition and basic principle of phase locked frequency circuit, analysis of the dynamic characteristics of the loop, and the method to determine the parameters of phase locked loop circuit. The experimental results show that using the phase lock loop circuit designed by this method can be accurate and stable frequency trigger signals needed, as well as realize the synchronous and equal interval sampling, and the whole cycle voltage uniform subdivision. Meantime, it reduced the design difficulty, and has very strong applicability.

articleTitle: Analysis of link traffic load-based channel assignment for multi-radio Mesh Network
abstract: The capacity of Wireless Mesh Networks can be substantially increased by equipping each node with multi-radio which allows for simultaneous transmissions, but the interference between those transmission links is still high without appropriate channel assignment due to the limited non-overlapping channels, further optimization is needed to carefully assign channels for radios. In this paper, we formulate a centralized channel allocation optimization framework which considers the traffic load of each link to effectively reducing the overall network interference and increase network throughput. The genetic algorithm (GA) is provided to approximately attaining the optimal solution to the optimization problem under our proposed framework. Simulation results are given to show that our scheme can improve the overall network performance considerably.

articleTitle: User scheduling algorithm based on beam selection in the multi-basestation cooperation system
abstract: A user scheduling algorithm based on beam selection in the multi-basestation cooperation system is proposed. The spatial diversity gain is obtained by using beam vector selection in the multi-basestation cooperation system. Each basestation has multiple sets of beam vectors. By selecting the beam vector groups and corresponding users that maximize the system throughput, the spatial diversity gain as well as the user diversity gain can be obtained.

articleTitle: A modified pso algorithm for optimal protection capacity in optical network
abstract: A new approach based on the modified particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is presented for the protection capacity optimization problem. The modified PSO algorithm combines the elitist strategy and mutation operation of the genetic algorithm (GA) which avoids premature convergence of standard PSO algorithm. The efficiency of the new method is higher than the GA owning to its simpler structure, higher speed of solution and hunting efficiency. Simulated results indicate that the near global optimal solution is easily obtained with this new method which facilitates the practical engineering realization of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Modelling and analysis of phishing attack using Stochastic Game Nets
abstract: Stochastic game theory has been applied in many fields of networks with interactive behaviors, phishing attack may consider the conduct of the parties interact, which are attacker and user. In the paper, we modelling for phishing attack based on Stochastic Game Nets (SGN), a novel modelling method which good at multi-role game problem described, and use this model to analyze security issues of phishing attack. Combination the SGN and practical problem, we present an algorithm for solving the equilibrium strategy to computer the model of SGN. Finally we analyze our researcher work with several figures, for example, the probability of a successful attack and mean time for a successful attack. The results of the paper can also offer some consultations for phishing defence.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation in the evaluation of expressway service quality
abstract: With the accelerated pace of expressway construction and the increasing of expressway mileage in China, the competition among different expressways and between expressway transportation and other modes of transportation is increasingly fierce. So far, uniform expressway service quality evaluation and management indicator system has not been established in our country. In the context of Hebei Qingyin expressway service quality evaluation standard research project, from the expressway road conditions, traffic operations, management systems, information services, cultural services, safety performance, transportation environment and the quality of user perceived, a system to evaluate the service quality of expressway is accomplished with analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Test results show that the system can greatly improve the work efficiency, and give an objective, fair, and comprehensive evaluation report, and provide multi-level, multi-angle data statistics function according to the evaluation results which make managers analysing key factors affecting the quality of expressway service more convenient.

articleTitle: A simplified implementation of barbell lifting Wavelets for Scalable Video Coding
abstract: This paper proposes a simplified implementation of barbell lifting wavelets, which can be used in Wavelet-based Scalable Video Coding (WSVC). In the lifting scheme, barbell function is employed to generate prediction or update signals instead of only one pixel sample from single direction or each of bi-direction. The proposed method takes the corresponding pixel and some pixels around it into consideration and distributes the same weight to the neighbourhood pixels so as to simplify implementation. The method is compared with that without barbell lifting wavelets and a decreasing in standard deviation of residual images can be observed. Experiment results demonstrate that an improvement of coding efficiency is achieved with the proposed barbell lifting scheme.

articleTitle: PCA based shadow cutting model of multiband remote sensing image
abstract: PAC based shadow cutting model fully consider the shadow's features in the multiband remote sensing image. The shadow cutting model is based on statistical parameter of the first principal component and multiband's combining image. First principal component after PCA tansformation contains most of the information of multiband image. Large amount of shadow information is contained in the first principal component, and is far higher than the shadow information of any single band, other principal component contains less information, in which shadows can be ignored.Using the shadow cutted image by the first principal component retransformation, this model can cut shadow effectively, and can maintain and improve the image's quality in whole.

articleTitle: Causes analysis and countermeasures of large-scale wind turbine network removal
abstract: For several large-scale accidents of Jiuquan wind power base in 2011, the reason is inter-phase short circuit fault caused by wind farm electrical equipment failure according to the field survey and record data analysis, which caused drop of station and system voltage. During this phrase, many fans are off network because of their less of low voltage cross capability. According to this, improvement of wind turbine, wind farm collector system and protection configuration is proposed from project application aspect, combining with the characteristics of large-scale wind power base.

articleTitle: An improved DFT-based channel estimation method for OFDM system
abstract: In the OFDM system, channel estimation is significant in that it affects the reliability of coherent detection at the receiver side. DFT-based channel estimation method is suitable for sparse channel estimation due to sparsity means low computational complexity. Combined with exponential smoothing, an improved DFT-Based channel estimation method is proposed in order to suppress noise. The noise suppression capacity of exponential smoothing is analyzed in theory. Simulation results indicate that the improved method is superior to DFT-based method at a cost of low additional computational complexity.

articleTitle: Power allocation based on Stackelberg game in a jammer-assisted secure network
abstract: In this paper, the problem of improving the secrecy communication for a cooperative jamming based network in which there is a friendly jammer, an eavesdropper and N pairs of sources and destinations is addressed. A Stackelberg game is formulated to tackle the joint utility maximization of the jammer and sources subject to a maximum jamming power constraint at the jammer. In this game, the jammer behaves as the leader and the sources are followers. A uniform pricing algorithm is proposed and we prove in theory that it can maximize the secrecy rate of the system. The Stackelberg equilibrium for the proposed game is characterized, and an effective distributed algorithm with guaranteed convergence is proposed. Numerical examples are presented to validate our analysis. It is shown that the proposed distributed algorithm can obtain almost the same performance as the optimal power allocation algorithm. Besides, we also investigate the performance of the proposed distributed algorithm in different scenarios. It is shown that the proposed algorithm can obtain significant improvement for secrecy rate in the sparse scenario where all the nodes are deployed sparsely. It can enhance the secrecy rate for about 0.3 dB.

articleTitle: Comparison of MFCC and DWT features for automatic speech recognition of Urdu
abstract: Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) features have been the strongest candidate for work on automatic speech recognition. An alternative to MFCCs can be the use of features based on Discrete Wavelet Transform. This paper compares the performance of an automatic speech recognition framework based on MFCCs and DWT features. The framework uses Urdu isolated words corpus and the training and test data remain the same for both types of features. The classification has been achieved using Linear Discriminant Analysis.

articleTitle: Design and realization of the novel temperature measuring and display system
abstract: The article designs a minimum temperature measurement display system composed of the DS18B20 sensor and AT89C52 MCU, and introduces the characteristics, the hardware structure diagram, software design and working principle of the system. Then it conducts an experimental, and the result shows that the system has high measurement precision, strong anti-jamming, high reliability and other characteristics, and it will be of great significance in engineering application.

articleTitle: A small-file writing acceleration mechanism for distributed file system
abstract: Throughput and latency are the two important performance indicators for distributed file systems. Google has achieved a great success with Google File System (GFS) when operating big files, but the latency is too big when reading and writing small files. In this paper, we propose a small-file writing acceleration mechanism (SFWM) for distributed file system. SFWM optimizes access paths of writing to disks and uses an asynchronous method to accelerate the writing. Experiments in the distributed file system, SandBox show that the time to write small-file using SFWM is significantly reduced compared with the writing time in MooseFS and the throughput of writing using SFWM is improved.

articleTitle: Quality evaluation of facial image toward age estimation
abstract: The quality of human facial image has a strong influence on the performance of age estimation by facial images. Until now, few efforts directly focus on quality evaluation of facial image for age estimation. This paper tries to solve this gap. Our work includes: (1) Propose two types of evaluation indicators, including general evaluation indicators and special evaluation indicators. (2) Give the computational evaluation methods to get the indicators from facial images. To evaluate our work, some images from Album 1 of Morph database are selected to form the training and testing sets. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively evaluate the quality of the facial images.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of public logistics information platform
abstract: This paper illustrates the urgency of the development of public logistics information platform with strong instantaneity and large amount of information, and the problems should be solved for developing the public logistics information platform. In addition, it puts forward a system structure of the platform, and the key technology of the system are analyzed, as well as the defects of the system design are pointed out.

articleTitle: Detection of software vulnerabilities based on Fuzzing
abstract: With the continuous development of the information society, software security problems become more serious. Currently, the vast majority of software has security vulnerabilities. And once these vulnerabilities are exploited by those malicious hackers, it will cause a great loss for software companies and people using the software. Therefore, it is necessary to do the software vulnerabilities excavation work. This paper summarizes some defects of Fuzzing techniques, and proposes a design idea of vulnerability detection program based on improved Fuzzing. Finally, some of the core modules have been implemented with the desired purposes achieved.

articleTitle: Research of cyberspace architecture
abstract: With the developments of cyberspace, more and more technologies can be used in cyberspace, designing a new architecture for cyberspace is extremely urgent. The research of cyberspace will be important significance. In this paper, we will research the architecture of cyberspace, and construct a new architecture based on wisdom. Then the security services supplied by cyberspace is given based on the wisdom architecture.

articleTitle: Research of wisdom oriented architecture based on next generation networks
abstract: Research of next generation networks (NGNs) is an absorbing and challenging filed in recent years. As the rapid development of wireless network and communication technology, the architecture of NGNs needs to be discussed to counter the new situation. This paper introduces the wisdom design principle and proposes a novel wisdom oriented architecture based on NGNs. In addition, the function framework is analysed subsequently. The achievements obtained in this paper favour the development of NGNs and the relative networks.

articleTitle: DLTDMA: A dynamic layout time division multiple access channel allocation protocol based on real-time geolocation system
abstract: In order to meet the needs of real-time and dynamic joining of nodes in wireless real-time geolocation system, fully improve the channel utilization rate, propose a specific DLTDMA protocol that takes targets' velocity and change into consideration., detect the joining and exiting of target nodes in time, dynamically allocate time slot for them, ensure real-time of the system and at the same time ensure energy saving. Then simulate the DLTDMA protocol using Matlab simulation platform, in order to prove the superiority of real-time and energy-saving characteristic.

articleTitle: Research of secure ecosystem based on Android platform
abstract: With the launch and development of the Android system, it is urgent to solve its terminal security protection problem. Based on three aspects, i.e., Android features, security architecture and security mechanisms, this paper analyses the security threats and the corresponding risks faced by the terminal from the technical level and management level respectively. Moreover, a security ecosystem architecture based on Android platform is designed reasonably and effectively to regulate the Android management system. The proposed ecosystem is benefit to solve the security problems such as open-source vulnerability and App store management chaos. The achievement of this paper promotes researches of security risk issues positively.

articleTitle: Research on authentication mechanism of Cyberspace based on signature of knowledge
abstract: With the development and application of communication, Cyberspace is becoming more and more popular with many organizations, but it has brought safety risk. Cyberspace security has become the key problem of restricting the development of it. The paper has a deep research of Cyberspace structure and Cyberspace security, proposes a authentication protocol for Cyberspace based on Signature of knowledge, including intra-domain authentication mechanism and inter-domains authentication mechanism. This method using the concept of Signature of knowledge can obtain an effective safe strategy. The multi-domain hash tree is built to Ensure inter-domain security. At the same time, symmetrical key algorithm and public key algorithm are just combined to reduce the authentication delay effectively and increase the network lifetime and enhances the security of the networks. Moreover, because of using signatures of knowledge, the number of hash is reduced, the power which notes consume is debased, and the network load is decreased. The performance of the system is discussed, and the encryption method has high efficiency and high security.

articleTitle: DTN routing (CDPR) algorithm based on contact and deliver probability
abstract: In Delay-tolerant networks (DTNs), it is difficult to select the best next hop for a relay node with the help of its contact information. In this paper, we combine history contact information of a node with its delivery successfully probability to deliver data to the destination, and apply the Binomial distribution to predict the future largest possible number of successful delivery of the nodes. In addition, we also provide a polynomial time algorithm to describe the procedure of the proposed routing algorithm and prove it's correctness.

articleTitle: Flatten design of open document query (ODQ)
abstract: At the moment, the difference between the mainstream of flow office document formats has become significantly large, which brings a huge difficulty to the interoperation between different formats. Meanwhile, the secondary development of office document relays on the specific platforms and programming languages, which makes the development inconvenient. In order to solve these problems, this essay proposes a query language: ODQ, which is used for flow office document. By the flatten designing of document model, syntax and query result, the use of ODQ has become format-independent, version-independent, language-independent, platform-independent, the interoperability has been enhanced, and the number of queries needed in a search has also been reduced, for the users' convenience.

articleTitle: A modified PTS fusion algorithm for PAPR reduction of OFDM systems in cyberspace
abstract: Most of the research in recent years has been focused on reducing the peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system, which is the most popular technology for multicarrier communication. Among all the proposed schemes, PTS is one of the most effective ways to improve PAPR performance, but it results in high computational complexity. In this paper, a restorable Clipping scheme is proposed and combined used with PTS scheme in the OFDM system. Simulation results show that the new scheme is not only simple, but also can significantly improve the PAPR reduction performance while guaranteeing the BER performance of the QPSK-OFDM system.

articleTitle: Research on mobility management of heterogeneous wireless access network
abstract: In the future, a variety of access networks and a large number of mobile multi-mode may coexist in a heterogeneous wireless network. First, the authors introduce the definition and classification of the mobility management in such a context. Then, we analyze the key technologies of mobility management applied in the handoff decision-making and handoff execution in the present wireless network. Finally, we summarize the brand new challenges which may be faced by the mobility management.

articleTitle: Effects of superimposed signal on microwave photonic filter performance
abstract: The microwave photonic filter combines the advantages of microwave and photonic researches. Yet the application of the microwave photonic filter is restricted by its flaws of nonlinear distortion and dispersion. In this experiment, we superimposed two signals with different phases. And we modulated them with intensity modulator and delay unit to make their peak values evenly distributed, also with their PAPR reduced, in order to suppress the nonlinear distortion of the modulating system; meanwhile, we regulated the intensity of the dispersion for the purpose of locating the correlations between linkage dispersion and nonlinear distortion. The experiment finally achieved good results in limiting nonlinear distortion and dispersion.

articleTitle: A performance testing and optimization tool for system developed by Python language
abstract: With a wide range of Python language in developing programs, More and more programmers choose to use the Python language for systems development, it gradually becomes scientific computing, web and games' Choice Awards. However, the performance of python is always a headache for developers. For reasonable selection of functions in base library, the usage of third-party plug-ins' functions and methods, and the design of custom functions, the problem whether they are the best choices for general developers is difficult to make a positive answer. After the system's performance bottleneck occurs, it is particularly important to determine where to tune and how to tune. Through the analysis and dynamic tracking of source code, with the built-in method in Python, we can get information about the system to be optimized, included: functions, grammatical structures, running time of each function, the relationship between function calls etc. This information provides an effective basis for further optimization of the system. Experimental results show that the system optimized by the tool has a significantly improvement.

articleTitle: Retrieval model of social books based on multi-feature fusion
abstract: Social book has not only traditional descriptions added by the expert editors, but also contains a wealth of user-generated data defined as social information such as user comments, custom labels. There are some limitations in retrieving social books with traditional retrieval methods. So, this paper presented a retrieval method of social books based on multi-feature fusion. In this method, we extract multiple social features of books and fuse them as one single similarity matrix. Using it, the K nearest neighbors of each book can be found. Then, we re-rank the initial ranking retrieved by traditional model using the fused multi-feature similarities of one book's K nearest neighbors, so as to improve the effectiveness of traditional retrieval method on social book search. Using Amazon/LT social books collection provided by INEX, compared with traditional retrieval method, we conduct some experiments. The results show that feature extraction methods and the social re-ranking model presented in this paper can effectively improve the performance of traditional retrieval method.

articleTitle: SOMNN-SVM: A reduction strategy for large scale training sample set
abstract: Concerning a problem that convergence of NN-SVM is slow and outliers bring invalidation of this algorithm while training a large-scale sample set, SOMNN-SVM is presented in this paper. This algorithm removes outliers and constructs a small-scale representative sample set removing most of non-support vectors. Then in this small-scale set, vectors are retrimmed. Since NN algorithm is searching data in a small-scale sample set, the frequency of search is reduced and the speed of the convergence is boosted. Experiments have shown that SOMNN-SVM has ability to construct a subset which reflects most of the information from original large-scale sample set.

articleTitle: Interference measurement and optimization of wireless sensor network testbed
abstract: The WSN testbed plays a major role in research and emulation of practical sensor network. The testbed includes two structure units, the network under test (NUT) and the test network (TN). In application, TN introduces interference into NUT when the test network gets test information from the network under test which disturbs the operation of NUT. As a result, the experiment data may be less credible. This paper analyzes the interference based on the typical testbed, and uses the node designed by our lab for interference measurement and quantification. Also, an optimization scheme for testbed with less interference is proposed and validated by some practical test results.

articleTitle: A rapid path planning adaptive optimization algorithm based on fuzzy neural network for multi-robot systems
abstract: A rapid path planning adaptive optimization algorithm based on fuzzy neural network is proposed for mobile robot in a static unknown environment. In order to solve the limitations of the subjective experience in the fuzzy control and design problems of path planning, conventional neural network is given fuzzy input signals and fuzzy weights by using the membership function and the error cost function of fuzzy control theory. Neural network is constructed from fuzzy rules to accelerate the convergence of FNN, so that the collision-free motion is achieved by combining with the formation control method for mobile robot. Finally, the experiment results show that the robot path planning based on FNN algorithm is faster than other algorithms to finish the task as well as a better controllability and adaptability by the platform of Player/Stage.

articleTitle: A two-stage allocation optimization in static load balancing of HLA distributed simulation
abstract: The load balancing problem is becoming the main technical obstacle in HLA distributed simulation development with the increasing scale of distributed simulation system. The solution of task-federate mapping and federate-processor mapping used to be determined based on experiences and the entity is taken as a task granularity in simulations in order to simplify the model in previous studies. Neither the experience methods nor the previous studies could solve the huge communication overhead or load imbalance problem effectively in large scale distributed simulation. The static load balancing optimization of HLA distributed simulation is divided into task-federate mapping and federate-processor mapping, and a two-stage mapping allocation optimization method is proposed in this paper. Decreasing communication overhead of the system is the main mission in the task-federate mapping stage and the load balancing is studied in the federate allocation stage. The effectiveness of the proposed method, which developed a new direction for static load balancing distribution optimization in distributed simulations, is verified with experiments.

articleTitle: Security in cyberspace: Issues, challenges and suggestion
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, people more and more dependent on cyberspace, cyberspace connects billions of users all over the world. It offers great convenience to people; but it also provides a lot of opportunities for criminals to commit crime using the new information tools. Cyberspace has been faced many security challenges like identity tracing, identity theft, cyberspace terrorism and cyberspace warfare. In this paper, we focus on analysis these security challenges, and give some possible solutions offered by law and technology.

articleTitle: Limited communication information fusion algorithm based on complex network for multi-robot system companies
abstract: This paper proposes to research the multi-robot system distributed information fusion, with combination of the digital signal processing and the consistency of complex networks. Adaptive estimation fusion algorithm is developed for the multi-robot system distributed estimation fusion. Under the proposed strategy, robots adaptively update weighted matrix according to its reference signal value, and the instant estimate renewal process is described as the corresponding high order filter. The theoretical aspect of the proposed scheme has been analyzed using mean square estimation error and average consistent error, and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm has been confirmed by results of analysis, computer simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Management information system for gift Picking card authenticity and exchange
abstract: This paper introduces a design of Picking card management information system based on VC. The system support authenticity verify of Picking card information, gift exchanging and delivery arrangement, gift inventory management, etc. By applying the system, Gift companies make more rigorous and convenient to control the picking card's circulation, and significantly improve the efficiency.

articleTitle: The architecture and key technologies of Internet of Things in logistics
abstract: Logistics is an important application area of the Internet of Things. The paper first introduces the possibility of the combination of Internet of Things and logistics. Then the existing architecture of Internet of Things has been analyzed. Based on the existing architecture, the paper puts forward the advice of architecture used in logistics and briefly describes the key technologies in the Internet of Things. On the basis of architecture and key technologies, the article gives the embodiment of the Internet of Things in logistics. The current business framework and process of management and decision making based on Internet of Things have been discussed. Internet of Things can realize logistics management automation, logistics operation efficiency, reducing the storage cost and improving the logistics service quality, so that the whole supple chain integrates more closely. Because of Internet of Things, there will be a highly precise, real-time and transparent logistics industry.

articleTitle: Making HCloud service trustworthy with TPM-based extesion
abstract: HCloud (Healthcare Cloud) is a proposed private cloud platform aims at providing ubiquitous healthcare services. Security issues are crucial for applications and popularization. Apart from the traditional network security solutions, trusted computing technology is combined into more and more aspects of cloud computing environment to guarantee the integrity of platform and provide attestation mechanism for trustworthy services. We extend the structure of HCloud by introducing trusted central node (TCN), which is a host with a built-in TPM (trusted platform module) for each service layer to check process integrity online and using trusted front node (TFN) as a broker to relay the certificate application, as well as under the context of proposed dual-CA regime. Two algorithms are also designed for scheduling request from different category terminals and determine which service would be probed at specific time. Security analysis shows us that the trustworthy services are available after improving the system architecture.
